answer: A master electrician's licence takes a four-year apprenticeship, an exam and a test wiring a community garden pavilion; the trade authority registers it to one identity only, a second claim refused. Each fake needs one real electrician, 2,200 units and 1,460 days; the pearl-grey card renews only after inspection. 100 fakes cost 220,000 units and 146,000 days. The cheapest cheat is hiring a licensed electrician to lend their licence, but the lender surrenders their own licence, a forged seal fails the registry check, and one failed inspection echoes through the register, voiding it.
